title: A cover by continuous matrix presentations of a lattice
statement: In the context of the specified-basis matrix calculation [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-pair-matrix-at-basis], every integral lattice pair P over V → U admits a covering sieve S of V [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] such that every arrow a:W → V in S has an invertible continuous coefficient matrix whose integral column image agrees with the embedded image of P on every object over W.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), pp. 59–60; A cover by continuous matrix presentations of a lattice

proof.text: Choose finite locally free generators q for P.module. At the identity object of Over V the sieve of objects admitting a map to some q.X(i) is covering. Transfer it along Sieve.overEquiv to a sieve S on V.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), pp. 59–60; A cover by continuous matrix presentations of a lattice

proof.text: For every member a:W → V of S, its membership supplies i and a factorization Over.mk a → q.X(i). Apply the specified-basis calculation to this factorization. Transport the harmless a ≫ id = a equation explicitly.
